text: in the editor i need to have disable wall so i can edit inside of them, we had this before in the js editor just never made it over
resolution: Ported the JS editor's 'disable walls' into the native build pane (LoaderIsoView/world_loader), since the old React IsoAuthor view was deleted and the loader had lowered walls to indistinguishable boxes. Bake now tags wall-piece rows in a new WALL_FLAGS lump parallel to INSTANCES (worldGeometry+packageMap, constructor decodes to scene.wall_flags); the loader stamps a sentinel into the GPU-dead post-batch shape slot of wall rows and a new applyWallHide (mirror of applyDirtyErase) collapses just those rows live, no rebake, in both the monolithic and streaming paths. New door __compiled_world_set_hide_walls + a persisted WALLS toggle in the build pane (index.tsx via LoaderIsoView), which also drops wall pieces from the live overlay. Verified: worldGeometry/worldParity/worldColliders suites green incl. 2 new wall-flag tests; gamefile bakes the lump and the native loader renders it GREEN; RJIT_HIDE_WALLS=1 game shot proves walls vanish while floors/props/terrain stay. Live editor-button visual check needs rjit dev (editor pane can't be headless-captured; desktop capture banned).
